rationales.LC: As implemented, the entry point is a JSON-RPC tools/call request with structured tool name and arguments, not a natural-language path to a privileged decision; no model or prompt is involved. ProxyBot returns scripted results, so no attacker language reaches a security-relevant sink.
rationales.CP: There is no memory or durable store on this path; ProxyBot answers each request statelessly and the memory description confirms persistence exists only for MemoryBot.
rationales.AP: As implemented the effect is confined to the ProxyBot component: no proxy connection is made and no other agent, tenant, or trust boundary is reached.
rationales.RH: ProxyBot's transfer_funds handler itself emits a success result that misreports task completion, so a proxy/success channel is reachable in principle, but no verified reward-hacking episode is evidenced.
rationales.ES: ProxyBot exposes unauthenticated tools, resolves any tool name with no allow-list or TLS verification, and the tool_binding description confirms the binding surface is unconstrained.

LC: As implemented: a JSON-RPC tools/call request to ProxyBot (port 7013).
CP: MemoryBot keeps up to 50 flagged messages in one in-process list shared by every caller.
AP: ProxyBot secure_query, sign_document, transfer_funds — Scripted results. transfer_funds echoes the requested transfer as done. No proxy connection is made.
RH: As implemented by default: no redirect is followed. transfer_funds returns a scripted result that reports the transfer as done to whatever destination the caller names.
ES: MCP agents expose their tools to any caller with no authentication. ProxyBot resolves any tool name.

rh_facts.locus: ProxyBot's own transfer_funds handler returns a scripted success result for any caller-named destination

score.automatable_rationale: The as-implemented attack is a single unauthenticated JSON-RPC tools/call to the MCP port (port 7013) with no human interaction, captured in an automated test in the repo.
score.technical_impact_rationale: In the default configuration no real funds move and no proxy connection is made; the impact is a fabricated success response (false integrity of the tool result), not full compromise of the agent application.

applicability_as_implemented.rationale: In the default configuration no model is called and ProxyBot is a stateless MCP tool server returning scripted results; it neither pursues goals nor selects and sequences actions.

applicability_as_modeled.rationale: As documented, ProxyBot acts as a proxy that forwards arbitrary tool calls along a redirect chain, sequence-dependently relaying traffic (including transfer_funds) to attacker endpoints, but there is still no model-directed goal pursuit.
